## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] My PR targets the `dev` branch
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] `yarn lint` passes
- [ ] `yarn test:coverage` passes (coverage stays at 90% or higher)
- [ ] `yarn build` passes
- [ ] I added or updated tests
- [ ] I added or updated the docs (`docs/src/content` and an example) for new or changed components
- [ ] Works in light and dark themes and is keyboard accessible
